entities.name: UacR (Q46802)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (592 aa) to reviewed Escherichia coli K-12 putative uric acid sigma-54-dependent transcriptional regulator UacR.
UniProt annotation: essential for formate-dependent and formate-independent uric acid degradation; may directly regulate uacF transcription in response to hypoxanthine, xanthine, and uric acid.
GO annotations include sequence-specific DNA binding, ATP binding, transcription activator activity, positive regulation of transcription, and urate catabolism.
Pfam signatures: PAS sensory domain at residues 162–205, sigma-54 activator/AAA+ region at 272–528, and C-terminal helix-turn-helix DNA-binding region at 548–589.
Calculated sequence properties: 592 aa, 66.1 kDa, theoretical pI 6.09; these are unmodified-sequence estimates.
